|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Target your undercover spy present with an opponent's character. Look at top X cards of opponent's Reserve Deck, where X = number of opponent's characters present with target. OR If your undercover spy on table, look at top card of your Reserve Deck. OR ▼ Undercover.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Informant (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy Undercover from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Peek at top X cards of opponent’s Reserve Deck, where X = number of opponent’s characters present with your Undercover spy. OR If your Undercover spy on table, peek at top card of your Reserve Deck.” '''What changed:''' “Target your undercover spy present with an opponent's character. Look” → “Deploy Undercover from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Peek”; “opponent's” → “opponent’s”; “opponent's” → “opponent’s”; “target.” → “your Undercover spy.”; “undercover” → “Undercover”; “look” → “peek”; removed “OR ▼ Undercover.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards3.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown); page 4, slip 38. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Informant]].
* Later text: [[Informant (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Informant (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Informant]].
